title: A Compass for the Horizon
author: Beatrix Ashgrove
blurb: August Nystrom, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
